name: J-Corp
summary: Perth ISP 'JCorp On-line' (JCORP Pty Ltd, later J-Corp Pty Ltd); WAIA WAIX-class member; ISP arm wound down ~2004-05 (J-CORP. PTY LTD, ACN 009 063 076).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of jcorp.com.au May 1998.

Homepage last captured Dec 2004; ISP era ended ~2004-05. ISP webmail hosts dropped between Dec 2003 and Feb 2004 and the homepage carried home-builder branding by Dec 2004 — the ISP arm wound up c. 2003-04, marginally earlier than the entry's c. 2005.

refs.label: The ISP-era webmail/gateway hosts still answered in Dec 2003 and were gone by Feb 2004.
By 4 Dec 2004 (content dated 2003) the homepage was the J-Corp home-builders brand; jcorp.com.au later redirected to bgchomes.com.au (2013).
Verified: the ISP's own 1999 page copyrights 'JCORP PTY LTD'
Current auDA whois (Sep 2026): the domain is still registered to the candidate entity under its exact ACN (auDA whois for jcorp.com.au)
